objective: Publish working BUKLOD PTT in the existing BUKLOD Expo Web Home and route, interoperable with Android without any Android OTA.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main SHA a0d986b835d778209fc3ab69a35a157798266d3b inspected 2026-11-11; Web route placeholder and Web entry hidden. Main Supabase yhanxndaqbmuzbdqlblu active; buklod-ptt-access v12 and buklod-ptt-captions v2 ACTIVE; shared PTT RPCs exist, PTT and membership tables RLS enabled. Current live Expo production web asset SHA not independently verified. Release is fail-closed pending exact RC build and live verification.
chosenApproach: Use platform-specific web PTT core based on existing low-level Stream browser SDK and shared secure membership token, floor lease RPC, and chat runtime; expose Web Home PTT door; retain native core unchanged; add web confirmation to existing caption consent UI; gate promotion on exact Expo Hosting production export.
selectionRationale: Reuses server membership/stream call and Android PTT floor control, avoids new service, native build, duplicate channels, and replacing currently functioning Android PTT. Platform file preserves behavior and limits regression.
alternativeApproaches: Create standalone PTT web microservice and database; rejected due duplication, security drift and unnecessary cost.
Import React Native WebRTC SDK directly into web route; rejected due native browser bundling incompatibility.
Selected: low-level Stream browser SDK with server-enforced scopes and existing RPCs, separate Expo Web source.
acceptanceChecks: BUKLOD Web Home shows PTT entry with linked /personal-home/ptt page, not a placeholder.
Signed-in active scope member sees authorized scopes and CH01–CH10; join only via server-issued PTT credentials, no arbitrary call create.
Web and Android join the same call ID; microphone muted before join, floor acquired before transmit and released on pointer-up, hidden tab, or unmount.
Remote audio renders with Stream bindAudioElement, browser speaker retry is available, and chat and captions consent remain functional.
Web PTT upload/build passes Node contracts and TypeScript; exact production Expo export RC and Supabase URL checked before production hosting publish.
Android PTT core, Android OTA workflow, main navigation, other calls and audio remain unchanged; no live claims before verification.
preserveBehaviors: Existing BUKLOD Android native PTT, channel monitoring, priority/SOS floor controls, and caption storage consent.
Existing authenticated scope membership and RLS for PTT messages, privacy and account isolation.
Other web video/audio calling, Wall audio, navigation and adverts, without forced pause of unrelated sounds.
No Android OTA or native build in this Web-only release.
